result.text: Static review of the current draft (not a GPU result): silu_repl stores pend={g:t,s:res} and returns res, but mul_repl tests pend.get("g") is a. The actual second-site a should be the returned res, so verify whether the countdown can ever progress. Also the docstring says every stub carries parent-equivalent bytes while rsqrt emits torch.empty and silu emits unactivated input. Those claims conflict. Any intentional joint intermediate change must have a proven closed consumer/alias boundary and repair every escape/failure, including exception after removing a marker. Existing full-workload validation remains authoritative; first-sample/window self-tests are not general proof. Preserve exact parent bundle and do not add dummy unused native calls merely to satisfy effective coverage. Please inspect and resolve these issues in your candidate as appropriate; no need to change quality criteria.
result.basis: Read-only static review of in-progress candidate; no GPU or acceptance claim.
